methods.name: private static void loadDefaultProperties()
methods.comment:
* Loads the default networking system properties
     * the file is in jre/lib/net.properties

methods.name: public static String get(String key)
methods.comment: * Get a networking system property. If no system property was defined * returns the default value, if it exists, otherwise returns * null. * @param key the property name. * @throws SecurityException if a security manager exists and its * checkPropertiesAccess method doesn't allow access * to the system properties. * @return the String value for the property, * or null

methods.name: public static Integer getInteger(String key, int defval)
methods.comment: * Get an Integer networking system property. If no system property was * defined returns the default value, if it exists, otherwise returns * null. * @param key the property name. * @param defval the default value to use if the property is not found * @throws SecurityException if a security manager exists and its * checkPropertiesAccess method doesn't allow access * to the system properties. * @return the Integer value for the property, * or null
